title: History / s
description: Seconds of play kept behind the now line during gameplay (5–60). A further fifth of that previews the upcoming map density ahead of it.

title: Show strain backdrop
description: Draw the map's difficulty strain (vosu performance graph) as a faint silhouette behind the trace, aligned to map time.

title: Orientation
description: auto = follow the page's box: vertical when taller than wide (time runs upward like the mania editor), horizontal when wider (time runs left to right).

title: Alignment
description: Mirrors the layout for the side of the stage it sits on. left = the page sits left of the stage: readouts and the trace's baseline face right, toward the stage. right = the mirror image. Horizontal boxes put the readouts on that side.

title: Backing
description: none = floats on the game. scrim = a soft dark glow behind it that fades out. panel = a graphite panel.

title: Show in song select and results
description: Song select: the map's strain density over its whole length and its average notes per second, plus your last run on it. Results: the whole run's KPS curve with peak, average and key count. osu! shows none of these, but the page keeps its gameplay position, which on those screens usually covers osu!'s own panels — enable it when your source sits somewhere free on them.

title: Accent
description: map = peak and live marks take the current map's colour (from its background, never shown). 18-lab = amber.
